purpose: Third bounded internet verification group for ten existing batch-51 candidates while the same V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. No second runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_route_policy: Only first-party operator pages, GOV.UK Companies House records and local-authority pages count as verified. Search snippets and third-party directories are not promoted. A route may verify a conflict without proving current occupation.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical parcel geometry is read.
